skills.name: tea-rags:analytics-rerank
skills.description: Internal step invoked by $filter-building, $risk-assessment. Pick tea-rags rerank preset, build `{custom: {...}}` weight set, or compose analytics-driven search (ownership, tech-debt, hotspots, code-review, security-audit, fragile-silo).

skills.name: tea-rags:architecture-diagnostics
skills.description: Check code layout — dependency direction, SDP violations, module borders, leaking abstractions, silent coupling, zone of pain, hub-like deps, layer map / move candidates. Triggers "is architecture right", "layering violations", "which layer", "wrong dependency direction", "shotgun surgery", "архитектурные нарушения". NOT risk/health (risk-assessment), NOT one failure (bug-hunt), NOT plain cycle listing (find_cycles).

skills.name: tea-rags:bug-hunt
skills.description: Failure source: buggy + fresh code vs symptom. Triggers "debug X", "why Y fails", "test fails", stack trace, "падает", "find bugs in X", "bug in X — compare Y", "suspects in X, Y", bugFixRate hit, "прочитай весь файл" of a hit, "где в коде строка 'X'", "когда появилась ошибка 'X'". Beats explore/risk-assessment. NOT git history w/o error ("посмотри через git": core), health scan, test counts, unindexed-edit empty scan (verification).

skills.name: tea-rags:data-driven-generation
skills.description: Decide HOW to write/change code from git signals on neighbors — mode CREATE/EXTEND/MODIFY, templates from proven low-churn code, reuse helpers. Triggers "implement function X", "add method to Y", "change behavior of X", "напиши функцию", "поправь метод", hotfix with location + fix named, "overlay labels → strategy?". NOT discovery ($explore), "which files must change" impact asks. NOT pure rename/extract (a file MOVE still runs it).

skills.name: tea-rags:explore
skills.description: Use for questions about existing code behavior, usages, structure, examples, or explicit pre-change context that need investigation. Not bug symptoms, implementation-plan authoring, or broad code-health audits.

skills.name: tea-rags:extract-project-patterns
skills.description: Internal step invoked by $data-driven-generation. Agentic-only — runs on any behaviorQuery / positiveIds handoff: proven code as code-gen templates, not test patterns.

skills.name: tea-rags:filter-building
skills.description: Internal step invoked by $analytics-rerank, $bug-hunt. Build tea-rags filter beyond `pathPattern`.

skills.name: tea-rags:force-reindex
skills.description: Force full re-index, zero downtime: new versioned collection built in background while search continues; alias switches atomically. Also for a corrupt index. Requires explicit user confirmation — NEVER invoke automatically.

skills.name: tea-rags:index
skills.description: Index/reindex codebase: new → alias + index (index-codebase --name); indexed → incremental; corrupt → force-reindex. NOT status checks (get_index_status).

skills.name: tea-rags:mr-review
skills.description: Signal-driven review of a merge request or local branch — rank diff risks (blast radius, fragile zones, missing tests), comments naming concrete fixes. Triggers "review this MR <url>", "review MR/PR", "review my branch", "проведи ревью MR", "сделай ревью ветки". NOT naming fit of my changes (review_changes naming), NOT reviewer context (requesting-code-review), NOT health scan w/o diff (risk-assessment), NOT debugging (bug-hunt).

skills.name: tea-rags:pattern-search
skills.description: Internal step invoked by $explore, $risk-assessment. Internal strategy for explore skill.

skills.name: tea-rags:refactoring-planning
skills.description: Turn architecture diagnosis into an ordered, simulated refactoring plan — findings → simulated ops order → Tasks for writing-plans. Triggers "plan a refactoring", "plan the architecture fix", "fix order", "refactoring roadmap", "спланируй рефакторинг". NOT diagnosis alone (architecture-diagnostics), NOT one in-file change (data-driven-generation), NOT health scan (risk-assessment), NOT plans for user-named files (writing-plans).

skills.name: tea-rags:refactoring-scan
skills.description: Internal step invoked by $bug-hunt, $explore, $refactoring-planning, $risk-assessment. Multi-preset breadth-first scan for refactoring candidates.

skills.name: tea-rags:report-issue
skills.description: File a GitHub issue for a TeaRAGs bug — gather env + diagnostics, check existing issues first, produce a pre-filled issue URL or gh issue create. Triggers "report a bug", "file an issue", "open a GitHub issue about this error", "зарепорти баг в tea-rags", "это похоже на баг tea-rags". NOT for user-fixable config / setup errors.

skills.name: tea-rags:risk-assessment
skills.description: Project/domain health — multi-preset risk scan (bugs, hotspots, tech debt) into tiers; "evaluate risks", "assess code health", "zones needing attention". NOT one-preset asks (analytics-rerank). NOT bug symptoms, even with zones ("проверь зоны A, B") (bug-hunt). NOT unframed "something's off in X" (systematic-debugging). NOT "what to refactor in X", "what breaks if I change <symbol>" (explore). NOT tests-at-risk (tests-as-context).

skills.name: tea-rags:tea-rags-core
skills.description: tea-rags core rules: code search, navigation and project data through the tea-rags MCP tools and resources. Load before any code search, navigation or code change in an indexed repository.

skills.name: tea-rags:test-first
skills.description: Internal step invoked by $data-driven-generation. Agentic-only RED-phase skill — writes failing tests BEFORE implementation, from spec/plan acceptance criteria or given test code verbatim, else one test per behaviour of the task.

skills.name: tea-rags:tests-as-context
skills.description: Internal step invoked by $data-driven-generation, $filter-building, $mr-review, $risk-assessment, $test-first. Agentic-only — surfaces DSL test chunks (chunkType "test" scenarios, "test_setup" fixtures) as context for review, verification, refactoring, debugging; a user asking for test patterns / conventions wants the dinopowers TDD wrapper, not this recipe.

skills.name: imagegen
skills.description: Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas.

interface.shortDescription: Generate or edit images for websites, games, and more
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $imagegen to make or edit an image for this project.

skills.name: openai-docs
skills.description: Use for Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, customization, automations, and self-knowledge—including 'you,' 'your,' 'this app,' or 'this coding agent' when they refer to Codex—and for OpenAI APIs/products and ChatGPT Work. Also use for model choice/migration, prompting, SDKs, Responses, Realtime, agents, evals, and Chat/Work/Codex comparisons. Do not use for generic app/software tasks that merely mention Codex.
skills.shortDescription: Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, and self-knowledge; OpenAI APIs and ChatGPT Work. 'You'/'this app' means Codex only.

interface.shortDescription: OpenAI and Codex docs for models, skills, tasks, and setup
interface.defaultPrompt: Use OpenAI Docs for official docs lookup, questions about Codex itself or Codex surfaces, model selection, model migration, and prompt-upgrade work.

skills.name: review-agent
skills.description: Perform a read-only, defect-first review of a specified code change and return every actionable finding. Use when another agent delegates review of uncommitted changes, a base-branch diff, a commit, or custom review instructions.

interface.shortDescription: Find actionable bugs in code changes
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $review-agent to review the requested code changes and return actionable findings.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Create or update a Codex skill with appropriately scoped instructions and any needed supporting resources.

skills.name: skill-installer
skills.description: Install Codex skills into $CODEX_HOME/skills from a curated list or a GitHub repo path. Use when a user asks to list installable skills, install a curated skill, or install a skill from another repo (including private repos).
skills.shortDescription: Install curated skills from openai/skills or other repos

interface.shortDescription: Install curated skills from openai/skills or other repos
